episodes.name: Whole Lotta Shakin'...
episodes.overviewEn: A criminal who has the power to start earthquakes demands that Bay City pay him millions of dollars,or he will release an earthquake to destroy Bay City once and for all.At the same time a crroked doctor is robbing a little girl of her life by illegally selling organs for profit,and she needs a kidney transplant in order to live.To make matters more serious,Bay City is completely evacuated over the earthquake threat with the exception of Johnny and Raleigh.They work together to locate the criminal and stop the threat of the earthquakes

episodes.name: I Left My Heart
episodes.overviewEn: A druglord that needs a new heart has his group hold a party of wealthy folks hostage in order to find a new donor, who ends up being Frank Dominus. NightMan has to get rid of a bomb that the group has placed in the building, then track down the druglord, his group, and their victim.

episodes.name: Still of the Night
episodes.overviewEn: A beast from another dimension has been brought to ours to serve as a high tech government project. When the beast gets loose, it begins infecting innocent people including Frank Dominus, and the only cure for this deadly infection is the blood of the beast itself. Johnny has to done the Nightman suit to track down the beast, while fighting for his own life since he's been affected as well.

episodes.name: Face to Face
episodes.overviewEn: E Haskell Bridges breaks out of prison after having a face makeover that allows him to shift his face into anyones he wants. His ultimate plot after reunting with his beautiful but evil galpal Samantha is to get revenge on Frank Dominus and Lt. Charlie Dann for putting him away. He goes to ""The House of Soul"" and gasolines the hall, igniting a fire that nearly kills Jessica Rodgers. Nightman saves her, then comes face to face with Bridges. Though Nightman suspects Bridges to be dead after he plummets him into the ocean, he's still alive, lounging on a beach somewhere with his galpal and waiting to return and get his revenge.

episodes.name: Chrome
episodes.overviewEn: Joran,one of the many that was struck by the same lightning that Johnny himself was struck by,has been gifted with two powers.One,he is given teleknesis,able to move things with his mind and Two,Joran is able to steal talent and resources from anyone he wants and their abilities as well at the moment of the persons death.He steals power from several of the cosmic receipents,stealing their powers,and growing ever stronger...and Johnny is next on the list.

episodes.name: Lady in Red
episodes.overviewEn: Petra, a Russian assassin that gave up that life and loyalty for the old Soviet Union after a blotched assassination attempt caused an innocent boy to get shot, finds herself once again forced into working for the other side when Stepov, the leader of the Russian mafia in San Fransico, California, holds her sister Lara captive, only promising her freedom if Petra assassinates Police Chief Ludlow during a costume ball. When Johnny Domino befriends Petra, the two fall in love and Johnny uses his sensorary powers to learn the truth about Petra's dark past and desperate future. Despite her true love for Johnny and reluctance to once again become a killer, out of loyalty and love for her sister, Petra has no choice. Aware that Johnny knows the truth, Petra tries to drug him to keep him away from the crime scene and possible death. Onto her plan, Johnny only pretends to drink the drugged wine and faint. Little does Petra know that her sister is infact in cahoots with the Russian mob, and wil

episodes.name: That Ol' Gang of Mine
episodes.overviewEn: After being unthawed by a descendant of the late John Edgar Hoover,Al Capone, John Dillinger,and Bonnie Parker are unleashed to wreak havoc upon Bay City and it's up to Nightman to stop all three of them.

episodes.name: Constant Craving
episodes.overviewEn: Nightman takes on a vampire that is in control of a reluctant Countess who needs the DNA strands of Frank and Johnny Domino to cure herself!

episodes.name: Do You Believe in Magic?
episodes.overviewEn: An evil magician named Selene visits the House of Soul and tortures Johnny Domino with twisted visions and his friends as well experience these visions which inclueds Nightman attacking Raleigh,the NightMan suit moving around by itself,attacking Johnny,and an age old argument between Johnny's young father and mother taking place right in the middle of the House of Soul and Nightman must stop her.

episodes.name: Nightwoman
episodes.overviewEn: A former police officer,Lorie Swift,is crippled in an accident by a vicious mobster after being uncovered in an undercover sting   posing as his girlfriend.A suit that blazes a bright resonating,living blue, comes fitted with electric blasts and gives her the ability to walk once again,helps her to get get revenge on the mobster.Johnny Domino is a victim of the electrical blasts and is revived after rest,and Lorie tells him of the impending danger on Frank and Charlie and how the mobster she is after is behind it.They team up to go after the mobster

episodes.name: Chrome II
episodes.overviewEn: Joran enlists the help of a fellow "star child", Rachael, who is able to hypnotize people with the power of her will to do her bidding to help him kill Johnny and assume his power.  They both follow Johnny and friends to a ski resort where Johnny is set to play to play with a famous musician,Woody Gillis.  Joran uses to Rachael as a deterrent to distract Johnny from who he really is and who his friends are,turning him into a detestable person.  The battle reaches it's climax where Joran leads Nightman to the top of a mountain known as "Devil's Run" for a showdown, hand to hand   With Johnny's friends trapped in a car under an avalanche that Joran caused,and time running out, Nightman ultimately fights Joran over the top of the mountain, and Joran falls to his death.

episodes.name: Bad to the Bone
episodes.overviewEn: E. Haskell Bridges is back and this time he is going after Johnny. He uses a device to knock Johnny out and assumes his face and proceeds to kill several and leave behind evidence that Johnny is the killer. Johnny not believing that he is a killer consults with Dr. Walton, who can't find anything wrong. Bridges with Johnny's face is approached by Raleigh, who shows him the Nightman suit which he takes after knocking Raleigh out. Johnny bumps into Bridges' female accomplice and starts to get visions from her of Bridges; she was about to zap him when Johnny grabs and locks her up. Johnny finds Raleigh unconscious and discovers that Bridges got the suit but Johnny has another suit which he puts on and goes after him. They battle in the air and Bridges falls to his death... or does he?

episodes.name: Devil in Disguise
episodes.overviewEn: Chang is back and hires the help of several under sea divers to help find the weapon that Nightman tossed into the ocean in their first meeting.  At the same time Chang traps Johnny in a repeating dream scenario through subliminal suggestion to keep Johnny of his trail to give himself more time to find the weapon, and rebuild it.

episodes.name: Amazing Grace
episodes.overviewEn: After a convenience store robbery results in a murder of Johnny's friend Buddy (which Johnny was unable to stop) Johnny begins to loose faith that he and "Nightman" are actually doing any good to relieve Bay City of evil. It takes a little bit of divine intervention from above to convince Johnny to that he is actually doing more good that he thinks... and not give up the Nightman suit!

episodes.name: The Ultraweb
episodes.overviewEn: After being struck by the fatal lightning storm a year before, computer genius Kieran Keyes created a living internet called the Ultraweb. After discovering the true identity of NightMan, Keyes lures Johnny's father Frank Dominus into the Ultraweb, ultimately creating a showdown between father and son - Dominus only knowing NightMan as Bay City's masked vigilante. NightMan threatens to put Keyes out permanently if he doesn't spare Frank's life and release him from the Ultraweb's confines. Keyes agrees to send Frank back, killing him in the process. NightMan makes a new archenemy.

episodes.name: It Came from Out of the Sky
Book of the Dead
episodes.overviewEn: Johnny Domino teams up with another of Dr Walton's patients, Trudy Thorpe, who needs his assistance in preventing the crooked Dr. Winslow Sutton from resurrecting the evil magician Barzun from the dead. Sutton's hope is to unite him with his daughter, and his wife Lucy so that they may all work together to take over the world by resurrecting more of the undead to serve as the new unhuman race. While battling Barzun's dark magic, Johnny/NightMan learns that he's a ""chosen one"" and that the lightning strike was no accident.

episodes.name: Dust
episodes.overviewEn: Night Man accidentally resurrects a mummified Egyptian queen, with predictably disastrous results. Queen Neftalah is on a quest for eternal life and supreme power.

episodes.name: The Enemy Within
episodes.overviewEn:
After Raleigh has a nightmare in which Kieren Keyes' Ultraweb causes the destruction of The House of Soul, a real nightmare occurs when the fulltime singer, Jasmine, is electrocuted during a performance by what appears to be a shorted wire in her microphone.

Johnny is almost certain Keyes is trying to get a singer inside the club to keep tabs. When time-to-time singer Crystal shows up to offer herself as a sub during Jasmine's recovery, suspicion arises as to if perhaps a past singer, who wants to have a full time gig at The House of Soul, was hired out by Keyes to carry out the sabatoge.

Briony, Johnny and Raleigh recall past singers and events surrounding them, hoping to piece together a suspect. When things get nearly hopeless, Jasmine return to The House of Soul, but acting differently. Raleigh discovers she's really Keyes' henchwoman, Ally, who has used Ultraweb technology to disguise herself as Jasmine.

episodes.name: Revelations
episodes.overviewEn: After visiting Lucien Orcus, Johnny uncovers a secret from his past that reveals he may have a brother.
